name: Souin Ningyou ~Inran Counseling~
original_name: 操淫人形～淫乱カウンセリング～
source:
Main character is a novice counselor. Yet another female patient complains about his advice not helping, so he violates her in anger and then tries to persuade her that it was required for treatment. Surprisingly, patient believes and recovers, so this technique gets applied to the next female patient...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名新手辅导员。还有一位女患者抱怨他的建议没有帮助，所以他愤怒地侵犯了她，然后试图说服她这是治疗所必需的。令人惊讶的是，患者相信并康复了，因此这项技术被应用于下一位女性患者……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
